sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — Website Speed Optimization Services Kochi

items.q: How is this different from Core Web Vitals optimization?
items.a: Core Web Vitals optimization targets three specific Google-measured metrics — LCP, INP, and CLS. Website speed optimization is broader, covering overall performance including server response, caching, and asset weight that affect the whole site.

items.q: What usually causes a slow website?
items.a: Common causes include unoptimized images, slow server response, excessive scripts, and missing caching configuration. A website speed audit Kochi identifies which of these apply to your specific site.

items.q: Will speed optimization affect my site's design or content?
items.a: No. Image compression services for websites and code minification services reduce file size and unnecessary code without changing how your site looks or reads to visitors.

items.q: Do you set up a CDN as part of this service?
items.a: Yes, where appropriate. CDN setup and optimization is included for sites serving visitors across multiple regions, including Gulf-based traffic alongside domestic Kerala visitors.

items.q: How much faster will my site actually become?
items.a: Improvement varies by starting point and issues found, but most sites see meaningful load-time reductions after addressing server response, images, and caching together rather than in isolation. We'll share expected improvement ranges after the initial speed audit rather than promising a fixed number upfront.

items.q: Is mobile speed handled differently from desktop?
items.a: Yes. Mobile website speed optimization is prioritized specifically, since mobile devices and connections are typically slower, and most search traffic is measured on mobile performance first.
